definitions.name: SharedEnvelopePolicy
definitions.source:
class SharedEnvelopePolicy:
    """Opt-in ONE-leaf constraints, on the caller's earlier monotonic origin.

    Budgets are brokered work, not all-kernel IO or a hostile-process sandbox.
    Each selected limit intersects, and never replaces, intrinsic policies.
    """
    origin: float
    end: float
    source_io: int = 4294967296
    prepared_bytes: int = 134217728
    commands: int = 16
    output_bytes: int = 16777216
    processes: int = 8
    rss_bytes: int = 268435456
    fds: int = 64
    control_messages: int = 4096
    control_wire_bytes: int = 67108864
    polls: int = 100000
    journal_events: int = 512
    journal_bytes: int = 1048576
    endpoint_bytes: int = 67108864
    measurement_completion: str = dataclasses.field(default="strict",kw_only=True)

    def __post_init__(self):
        for name in ('origin','end'):
            v=getattr(self,name)
            if type(v) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(v) or v<0:
                raise engine.Failure('invalid-envelope-policy:'+name)
        if not 0<self.end-self.origin<=960:
            raise engine.Failure('invalid-envelope-policy:end')
        maxima=dict(source_io=4294967296,prepared_bytes=134217728,commands=16,
            output_bytes=16777216,processes=8,rss_bytes=268435456,fds=64,
            control_messages=4096,control_wire_bytes=67108864,polls=100000,
            journal_events=512,journal_bytes=1048576,endpoint_bytes=67108864)
        for name,maximum in maxima.items():
            value=getattr(self,name)
            if type(value) is not int or not 0<value<=maximum:
                raise engine.Failure('invalid-envelope-policy:'+name)
        if (type(self.measurement_completion) is not str
                or self.measurement_completion not in ('strict','bounded-original-v1','bounded-original-v2')):
            raise engine.Failure('invalid-envelope-policy:measurement_completion')

definitions.name: open_session
definitions.source:
def open_session(workspace,stream,managed,*,envelope:SharedEnvelopePolicy|None=None):
    global _ACTIVE_SESSION
    if _ACTIVE_SESSION is not None:
        raise StartupFailure('InvalidLease',_partial(None))
    if (type(workspace) is not artifacts.NewWorkspace or type(workspace.path) is not str
            or type(stream) is not artifacts.StreamPolicy
            or type(managed) is not ManagedPolicy or threading.active_count()!=1
            or threading.current_thread() is not threading.main_thread()):
        raise StartupFailure('InvalidLease',_partial(None))
    if envelope is not None:
        if type(envelope) is not SharedEnvelopePolicy:
            raise StartupFailure('InvalidLease',_partial(None))
        envelope.__post_init__()
        if envelope.origin>time.monotonic() or time.monotonic()>=envelope.end:
            raise StartupFailure('EnvelopeDeadline',_partial(None))
    _source_check()
    if envelope is not None and time.monotonic()>=envelope.end:
        raise StartupFailure('EnvelopeDeadline',_partial(None))
    directory=engine._path(workspace.path)
    fd=journal=parent_fd=-1;pipes=[];pid=None;pidfd=None
    read=write=-1;durable=False;workspace_created=False;journal_created=False
    generation=uuid.uuid4().hex
    try:
        if envelope is not None and time.monotonic()>=envelope.end:
            raise engine.Failure('EnvelopeDeadline')
        os.mkdir(directory,0o700);workspace_created=True
        fd=engine._open_path(directory,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY)
        workspace_stamp=engine._stamp(os.fstat(fd))[:3]
        journal=os.open('session.jsonl',os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600,dir_fd=fd)
        journal_created=True
        journal_stamp=engine._stamp(os.fstat(journal))[:3]
        raw=json.dumps(dict(phase='OPEN_INTENT',generation=generation,coordinator=os.getpid())).encode()+b'\n'
        engine.append_journal(journal,fd,'session.jsonl',journal_stamp,raw)
        os.fsync(fd);durable=True
        if envelope is not None and time.monotonic()>=envelope.end:
            raise engine.Failure('EnvelopeDeadline')
        parent=os.getpid();parent_fd=os.pidfd_open(parent)
        pipes=[os.pipe2(os.O_CLOEXEC|os.O_NONBLOCK),os.pipe2(os.O_CLOEXEC|os.O_NONBLOCK)]
        pid=os.fork()
        if pid==0:
            try:
                read,write=pipes[0][0],pipes[1][1]
                keep={0,1,2,fd,journal,parent_fd,read,write}
                for entry in os.listdir('/proc/self/fd'):
                    item=int(entry)
                    if item not in keep:
                        try:os.close(item)
                        except OSError:pass
                resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(268435456,268435456))
                resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))
                resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE,(64,64))
                worker=_Worker(directory,fd,journal,read,write,parent,parent_fd,generation,stream,managed,envelope)
                worker.loop();os._exit(0)
            except BaseException:
                os._exit(125)
        os.close(parent_fd);parent_fd=-1;os.close(fd);fd=-1;os.close(journal);journal=-1
        os.close(pipes[0][0]);os.close(pipes[1][1])
        write,read=pipes[0][1],pipes[1][0];pipes=[]
        pidfd=os.pidfd_open(pid)
        session=Session(_SESSION_KEY);session._initialize(pid,pidfd,read,write,generation,managed,str(directory),envelope)
        # HELLO is unsolicited sequence0 and has the same commit discipline.
        hello=session._transport(None,min(time.monotonic()+managed.startup_seconds,envelope.end if envelope else float('inf')))
        if (hello.get('generation')!=generation or hello.get('sequence')!=0 or not hello.get('ok')
                or hello['value']['supervisor']!=pid or hello['value']['parent']!=parent
                or tuple(hello['value']['root'])!=workspace_stamp
                or tuple(hello['value']['journal_identity'])!=journal_stamp
                or hello['value']['source']!=sys.modules[__package__].source_binding()):
            raise engine.Failure('LaunchUnknown')
        expected_mode=envelope.measurement_completion if envelope is not None else 'strict'
        value=hello['value'];ack=value.get('measurement_completion','strict')
        if (set(value)-{'supervisor','parent','root','generation','source','journal_identity','measurement_completion'}
                or type(ack) is not str or ack not in ('strict','bounded-original-v1','bounded-original-v2')
                or ack!=expected_mode):
            raise engine.Failure('LaunchUnknown')
        observed=engine.Identity.observe(pid)
        fields=Path('/proc',str(pid),'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()
        if int(fields[1])!=parent:raise engine.Failure('LaunchUnknown')
        observed.verify()
        _ACTIVE_SESSION=session
        return session
    except BaseException as error:
        for pair in pipes:
            for item in pair:
                try:os.close(item)
                except OSError:pass
        for item in (fd,journal,parent_fd):
            if item>=0:
                try:os.close(item)
                except OSError:pass
        if pid is not None:
            # Only close owned control ends. Worker independently detects parent/control loss.
            for item in (locals().get('write',-1),locals().get('read',-1)):
                if item>=0:
                    try:os.close(item)
                    except OSError:pass
        code=error.code if isinstance(error,engine.Failure) else ('NoClobber' if isinstance(error,FileExistsError) else 'ControlLost')
        reaped=False;reap_proof=None
        if pid is not None:
            until=time.monotonic()+1.3
            while time.monotonic()<until:
                try:
                    done,status=os.waitpid(pid,os.WNOHANG)
                    if done:reap_proof=dict(kind="waitpid",pid=done,status=status)
                except ChildProcessError:
                    done=pid;reap_proof=dict(kind="no-unreaped-child",pid=pid)
                if done:
                    reaped=True;break
                time.sleep(.01)
        if pidfd is not None:
            os.close(pidfd)
        observation=PartialOutcome(code,'NOT_ATTEMPTED',None,None,(),
                                   'STOPPED' if pid is None or reaped else 'UNKNOWN',(),durable)
        failure=StartupFailure(code,observation)
        if envelope is not None and envelope.measurement_completion in ('bounded-original-v1','bounded-original-v2'):
            candidate=locals().get('session');committed='hello' in locals()
            failure.creation=_frozen(dict(workspace_created=workspace_created,
                journal_created=journal_created,journal_durable=durable,
                supervisor_fork_returned=pid is not None,supervisor_pid=pid,
                supervisor_reap_proof=reap_proof,
                cleanup='STOPPED' if pid is None or reaped else 'UNKNOWN',
                committed_hello_received=committed,
                received_wire_bytes=candidate._transport_received if candidate is not None else 0,
                received_messages=candidate._messages if candidate is not None else 0,
                outstanding_response_bytes=0 if committed else None,
                outstanding_response_messages=0 if committed else None,
                outstanding_response_upper_bound_bytes=0 if committed else 65796,
                outstanding_response_upper_bound_messages=0 if committed else 2,
                facts_only=True))
        raise failure from error
